## Type of change

- [ ] Correction (factual error, outdated claim) — evidence linked below
- [ ] New content (vector write-up, diagram, translation)
- [ ] Exercise improvement (teaching-lab only)
- [ ] Meta (CI, templates, docs hygiene)

## Scope check (required)

- [ ] Adds no deployable attack tooling, lure pages, relay infra, mainnet configs, or keys
- [ ] Offensive details are paired with detection/defense value
- [ ] Testnet-only examples; any addresses belong in the appendix

## Self-review checklist

- [ ] Markdown renders correctly on GitHub (tables, mermaid, relative links)
- [ ] Claims are sourced or clearly marked as analysis/opinion
- [ ] Follows the style conventions in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)
